scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible JSON chunks.

summary.scope: Solved independent full-arm/FEM contact hold, explicit support control and third U spatial level

coupled_pilot.scope: Solve held initialization then free FEM/complete Panda joint contact dynamics.
coupled_pilot.limitations: Complete nine-joint nonlinear kinematics/PD/equality and independent FEM/contact are coupled with original1e-9 body/joint force gates and fresh MuJoCo step checks. Held six-point quasi-static initialization followed by zero initial velocity differs from original approach/lift and captured angular history. Endpoint implicit body/contact/PD forces use a MuJoCo old-state step response; time-integration, history, spatial/contact/regularization and native feedback/model/accuracy-cost still need qualification. Newton CCD guards accepted endpoint chords; no continuous nonlinear rigid-motion CCD claim is made. This is an application pilot, not completion of full physical acceptance.

independent_support_audit.scope: Reconstruct full body and joint balances independently of the coupled Newton solver.
independent_support_audit.limitations: All retained steps reconstruct complete body and joint balances, actual contact pullback and a fresh independent robot step with original1e-9 budgets. Volume quadrature tensor comparison is objective. Prescribed-arm reactions are explicit and all other matched protocol inputs remain fixed. This support-axis comparison does not establish rigid/deformable feedback, matched original approach/angular history or physical mesh/contact/time convergence.

u_spatial_tail.scope: Reconstruct three resolved U fields and retain their unresolved spatial tails.
u_spatial_tail.limitations: Body geometry and pad discretization change together. The final-level common-x gauge/cache is an explicitly qualified reference numerical option, not a changed physical load. Original linear body/pad laws remain: finite-rotation/nonlinear compliance, separated geometry/contact axes, regularization/history tails and native feedback/model/accuracy-cost acceptance remain required. No tail passes merely from three levels or a stable resultant. Raw global peaks and outside probes remain visible.

failures: Full-arm v2 Newton stalls at step31 above original budgets; its exact failed state is retained.
Fixed-arm v2 fresh-step check fails at step69. Only states through68 were saved by that driver.

U audit v1 compared raw-coordinate and gauge-projected stiffness arithmetic at1e-12. Audit v2 retains this comparison in consistent gauge and separately verifies raw-coordinate balance at original1e-9.

limitations: The solved short hold uses a held-body initializer and zero initial velocities at one coarse setting. Original approach/lift/angular history, temporal/spatial/contact/regularization tails, feedback versus load mapping, applicable model comparisons and warmed physical accuracy/cost remain incomplete. U third-level tensors still change12.2%. Successes and failures retain exact original files; live jobs are excluded. The earlier articulated-spatial manifest retains complete capture provenance without duplicating every motion frame here. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
